title: German Cassaba Pilaf
description: A resinous, dense, and light German dish featuring cassaba and low-sodium-friendly ingredients, served in a salt block vessel.
instructions: Prepare the salt block vessel by rinsing it under cold water, then drying it thoroughly with a clean towel.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the small diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cassaba, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 5-6 minutes, until the cassaba is lightly browned.
Add the fried-grind-rice-khao-khua and cook for 2-3 minutes, until combined with the cassaba mixture.
Add the water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 15-20 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the pilaf is lightly browned.
Transfer the pilaf to the prepared salt block vessel and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
